name: nlp_gpt_pretrain_clean
title: The correct twin of nlp_gpt_pretrain: accumulation, AMP, clipping, cosine schedule, torch.compile and a state-dict resume, all wired right
origin: hardening round 1, domain-nlp, 2026-09-13 - the false-positive trap for the whole training-mechanics family
note: Measured 0 findings and 0 diagnostics in both --dataflow local and --dataflow ip on 2026-09-13. This is the hardest negative in the NLP set: a gradient-accumulation loop with AMP is the shape MLV201, MLV202, MLV208 and MLV209 are most likely to get wrong.

forbidden.why: optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is on line 58, inside the `(step + 1) % ACCUM_STEPS == 0` guard - the accumulation shape MLV201's note (a) says must not fire
scaler.step(optimizer) is on line 56, inside the same guard
torch.autocast is not a no-grad context and there is no torch.no_grad() block in this project
total_loss accumulates loss.item() on line 59, a float
CosineAnnealingLR(T_max=EPOCHS) is stepped on line 60, in the epoch loop, which is its documented cadence
the AMP sequence is complete and in order: scaler.scale(...).backward(), scaler.unscale_(optimizer), clip, scaler.step(optimizer), scaler.update()
clip_grad_norm_ (line 55) sits after unscale_ (line 54) and before scaler.step (line 56), which is the only correct position
the training loader passes shuffle=True on line 30
inputs and targets are both moved on lines 47-48 before the forward on line 51
the device comes from torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu") on line 75
torch.manual_seed(SEED) is the first statement of train() (line 35)
torch.save writes a dict of state_dicts (lines 62-63) and torch.load passes both map_location= and weights_only=True (line 68)
the head returns raw logits (line 76); F.cross_entropy applies the log-softmax itself
no sigmoid and no BCE loss appear anywhere in this project
all three nn.Module subclasses call super().__init__() on the first line of __init__ (lines 21, 44, 62)
the block stack is wrapped in nn.ModuleList (line 65) and the MLP in nn.Sequential (line 48)
there is no evaluation region in this project; a pre-training script that only trains is not an evaluation defect
